name: ShroudForge Flight
description: Keeps the local player's typed DynamicLocomotion state in Flying mode.

changelog: Added the declarative ShroudForge settings page.
Added a safe action to reset the current flight state.
Added control over downward flight movement.

settingGroups.label: General
settingGroups.description: Core flight behavior. Changes apply after the runtime restarts.

settings.label: Prevent fall damage
settings.description: Clears the local fall-damage state while flight is active.

settings.label: Allow downward movement
settings.description: Preserves negative vertical input instead of clamping it to zero.
